claim: Claude Fable 5.2 is listed active with release date November 9, 2026.
qualifiers: Known calendar date; no launch hour established.

claim: The documented interface is text and images to text, with 1M context and 128K maximum output.
qualifiers: Interface limits do not establish accuracy at full context.
limitations: No native image, video, or audio generation established by this page.

claim: Adaptive thinking is always on; API default effort is high; forced tool use returns a 400 error and the page instructs omitting temperature, top_p, and top_k.
qualifiers: Apps and Code defaults are separate from API defaults.

claim: Fable and Mythos share an underlying model; Fable has stronger cyber/biology safeguards, while Mythos is available through organizational verification programs.
qualifiers: Verification application is not immediate entitlement.
limitations: Individual program eligibility and user access were not tested.

claim: The release describes medium as the default effort in Claude apps and Claude Code.
qualifiers: API specifications separately list high.
limitations: Actual user settings were not inspected.

claim: Demonstrations and comparisons remain vendor reports; formalization figure describes roughly 1,000 agents and one run per model; external evaluators did not review or endorse the release text.
locator: Mathematics figure; evaluations table notes; footnote 4
qualifiers: No direct model ranking inferred from differing effort settings or cyber task sets.
limitations: System card was linked but not acquired; no independent replication performed.

claim: Fable 5.2 requires 30-day retention and zero-retention access needs Anthropic authorization.
qualifiers: Authorization exception is narrower than a universal zero-retention option.

claim: Enterprise Frontier Safeguards is in private beta and described as monitoring prompts/responses in customer infrastructure; authorized eligible customers have a zero-retention path.
locator: Data privacy and Enterprise Frontier Safeguards
qualifiers: Other customers are described as having 30-day safety-monitoring retention.
limitations: Private-beta configuration and customer eligibility untested.

claim: The announcement describes fallback responses for blocked cyber/biology requests and limited AI-development topics.
qualifiers: Retain actual serving-model information and refusal outcomes.
limitations: No fallback was invoked or inspected live.

claim: Anthropic recommends starting with Opus 5.5 for most work and escalating to Fable for demanding reasoning or when higher-effort Opus evaluations fall short.
qualifiers: Vendor selection guidance, not a measured recommendation for every workload.

claim: First-party pricing lists Fable/Mythos 5.2 at USD $8/$40 per million input/output tokens, versus 5.1 at $10/$50, a 20% rate reduction.
qualifiers: 20% is arithmetic on listed rates, not task-cost measurement.
Rates observed November 11, 2026.
limitations: Partner-operated cloud prices and extras can differ.

claim: Five-minute and one-hour cache writes are $10/$16 per MTok; reads $0.20. Batch rates are $4/$20. Fast mode is $16/$80, incompatible with batch, and can stack modifiers.
passages: Fast mode is not available with the Batch API.
locator: Model pricing; fast mode; batch; long context
qualifiers: Full context at standard per-token pricing; actual totals depend on request history and applicable modifiers.
limitations: No billing measurements or invoices reviewed.

claim: At base uncached rates, 100,000 input tokens plus 10,000 billed output tokens cost $1.20 in token charges.
qualifiers: Illustrative arithmetic: 0.1×8 + 0.01×40 = 1.20.
Includes all billed output in the hypothetical output count; excludes tools, additional requests, taxes and modifiers.
limitations: Not a real project quotation or measured usage.

claim: Thinking binds to earlier system, tools and messages; ordinary Fable/Mythos 5.2 API prefix mismatches default to 400 errors for all accounts, while unset batch items drop affected blocks.
locator: Who the prefix check affects; keeping the prefix unchanged; batch behavior
qualifiers: A first successful turn does not test replay compatibility.

claim: Explicit drop_block mode is a stopgap that discards invalidated reasoning, restarts caching at the edit, and can increase output-token use and latency.
passages: a stopgap with an output-token cost
locator: What the API does with an invalid block; output-token cost
qualifiers: Effects vary with harness and frequency of edits.

claim: Model-incompatible reasoning may be dropped without error; Fable/Mythos 5.2 thinking is account-bound unless accounts are linked.
qualifiers: Not equivalent to portable cross-account conversation state.

claim: Advisor is experimental on the Anthropic API and Claude Platform on AWS, with version/access/pairing constraints; Fable 5.2 needs Code v2.1.321+.
passages: Fable 5.2 requires Claude Code v2.1.321 or later
qualifiers: Not available through Bedrock, Google Cloud Agent Platform or Foundry according to this page.
Some plans require Fable usage-credit consent.
limitations: No advisor configuration changed or executed.

claim: Advisor reads full conversation and adds token usage; its reads are not cached across consultations, and rejected pairings may cause a retry without an advisor.
locator: Cost; impact on prompt caching; pairing validation
qualifiers: Model-driven timing; task completion is not proof that advice occurred.
limitations: No measured savings or advisor success rate established.

claim: Commercial service terms permit customer products subject to terms, allocate content rights between parties, require output checks, and retain restrictions; consumer terms are separate.
qualifiers: Contractual allocation between parties is not a model-weight license or a guarantee of third-party rights.
June 17, 2025 is the displayed effective date, not an established publication date.
limitations: No downloadable weights or local deployment license established; not individualized legal advice.
